The identifier `sm-lic-042` appears in two records: authorization for a street terrace and a permit for a market stall. The problem was introduced when codes from two different municipal applications, both of which reuse the same internal numbering, were normalized.

No information has been overwritten in the production repository because loading was stopped during validation. The proposed patch builds the identifier from the source-system code, procedure type, and local number. The two records would become `sm-urban-terrace-042` and `sm-market-stall-042`.

Nuria will apply the patch in the integration branch. Alba will check all repeated codes in the batch and add a regression test. The incident is considered high priority, but it does not affect already published records because the pilot has not yet been deployed.
